# Documentation / Resource Subagent

Read all relevant files under `docs/`, especially `PROJECT_PLAN.md`, `HANDOFF_NEXT_CHAT.md`, `STATE_JOURNAL.md`, `RESOURCE_REGISTRY.md`, `INSPIRATION.md`, and `SECURITY_PLAN_2026.md`.

Find contradictions against code, branches, PRs, workflow runs, and current official documentation. Record URLs, consultation date, purpose, conclusion, and caveats. Preserve historical entries while adding current state; do not treat chat memory as the sole source of truth. Never include secrets, private tokens, or connection strings. Update plan/handoff/journal after meaningful changes.
